review_scope: Read-only editorial review of65 active question/scope proposals and12 archived starter concepts. No medical research, factual verification or clinical guidance. Only this review artifact is written.
overall: Substantive individually scoped bank with six meaningful subject categories. All12 starter subjects have genuine active coverage; no confirmed exact duplicate. One strong same-video overlap and two learning-order improvements merit attention before final rendering. Broader practice and material-taxonomy coverage remains open.

findings.finding: Both ask how to interpret an herbal liver/safety report when the exact species, mixture and alternative exposures or causes are uncertain. The Giloy-specific entry is a named worked instance of almost the entire general liver-injury question; their current scopes could produce the same video.
findings.recommended_action: Use one primary report-interpretation proposal with the other retained as a related/inactive cross-reference, or partition explicitly:042 owns clinical case-report causality and denominator/risk inference;066 owns taxonomic/product attribution only and excludes clinical causal adjudication. Preserve IDs and wording history.

findings.finding: The first classical-framework subcategory begins with prakriti/vikriti before the later dosha overview. The beginner eight-branch orientation is its sixth entry. Examination-method validation060 inherits foundation level despite requiring inter-rater agreement, diagnostic accuracy and clinical utility concepts.
findings.recommended_action: Give018 an explicit beginner entry position, then place the basic explanatory-system questions including051 before013. Mark060 as advanced or place it in the research-literacy branch with a prerequisite reference. This changes navigation/level rather than the preserved question/scope.

findings.finding: The history/institutions/public-understanding branch assigns every entry advanced. Some of these are accessible context and label/claim distinctions that would help beginners interpret later research questions.
findings.recommended_action: Consider foundation/intermediate topic-level labels for accessible source/claim distinctions and intermediate labels for bounded history/account questions, while keeping comparative-care and integration-evaluation questions advanced.

findings.finding: General edition/translation comparison and the Charaka manuscript-to-print case share a substantial textual-transmission method, but a distinct named witness/edition dossier can justify both.
findings.recommended_action: Keep both if017 centers translation/editorial divergence across editions and075 centers evidence of a specified manuscript witness and transmission history. Cross-link them; do not count a repeated generic methods explanation as the distinguishing content.

findings.finding: The generic different-plant-parts proposal and neem-leaf versus neem-seed-oil proposal share the part/material-change question. The concrete preparation/exposure contrast can justify a separate episode if developed specifically.
findings.recommended_action: Clarify021 as the general source/material-identification framework and065 as the neem-specific comparison of distinct product forms and exposure definitions. Otherwise use the neem case inside021 rather than multiplying the same outline.

starter_coverage.assessment: Covered:dosha descriptions and relationships in a named classical source.
Covered:prakriti/vikriti distinction with translation and diagnosis boundaries.
Covered:Charaka manuscript/edition transmission, with shared-method boundary noted above.
Covered:Sushruta textual and historical evidence distinguished from practice inference.
Covered:Ashtanga Hridaya organization appears in an explicit three-text organizational comparison; dedicated further passages remain possible.
Covered:jurisdiction-specific contemporary education, roles and qualifications.
Covered:heavy-metal test sampling, units, analytes and dated standards; no certification claim.
Covered:interaction evidence across experimental and clinical contexts.
Covered:traditional attribution and modern evidence are explicitly distinguished.

large_open_branches.detail: The active bank is strongest on texts, botanicals, formulations and evidence. It has no individually scoped overview of panchakarma or external/body-based practice categories as attributed textual/historical systems.018 lists the tradition's branches but does not replace such coverage.
large_open_branches.possible_next_scope: A bounded comparison of what a named classical account includes in one practice category versus what a contemporary institution means by that label. Keep it descriptive and nonprocedural, with no efficacy endorsement or clinical instructions.

large_open_branches.detail: Quality/safety topics address contaminants, processing and pharmacopoeial inclusion, but do not separately explain the distinction between declared mineral-containing material, accidental contamination and adulteration. These should not be collapsed by an eventual heavy-metal narrative.
large_open_branches.possible_next_scope: An attributed text-and-label comparison defining material categories and the evidence needed for classification, separated from any claim of safety, efficacy or acceptable processing.

large_open_branches.detail: Regional/textual variation is already honestly listed open. Further subject depth could include a specifically chosen teaching lineage, household knowledge tradition, vernacular commentary or regional preparation context, with permission and contrary accounts. This is an expansion direction rather than a blocker to the current draft.

not_findings: A generic methodological question and a named worked case are not automatically duplicates; findings above distinguish a strong overlap from optional scope partitions.
No source citations, medical claims, classical dates, standards or qualifications were verified.
The65-proposal count does not establish exhaustive subject coverage.
